title: Bill Moore did work for the CIA

tellings.quote: and what he told me is he said I didn't work for them I did some work I did some work for them but I didn't work for them

plain: A man named Bill Moore did jobs for the CIA, the US spy agency, but says he was never on its staff. The researcher Grant Cameron passes on Moore's own words to him: "I didn't work for them, I did some work for them, but I didn't work for them." If true, it would mean Moore had a quiet working tie to the agency.
